pairs.difference: A: the sign stands right of centre. A cropped motel with balcony and lit windows fills the left, with a fence, tree, mountains, clouds and stars behind, so the setting takes about half the card and the hero shares it. B: the saloon fills the card, and its setting is only sky, two distant mesas and a few tufts and pebbles on sand. Both measure in range, so this rests on my eye.
pairs.fix: Put the sign in the centre and make it larger. Replace the motel, fence and tree with one dark, simple building shape and a plain night sky gradient.

pairs.difference: A: crisp concentric green rings with a clean lit centre, category 1. B: the same ring idea in pink, but the bands are hazy, a pale bloom sits behind the pillow and a corner turns purplish. Its detail of 0.0159 is just above the real range, while A is at the low end.
pairs.fix: Draw flat, even pink rings with clean edges and only a soft lighter centre. Remove the pale bloom behind the pillow and keep the corners the same hue.

pairs.difference: A: the plank shelf is a category 3 material with seams, grain, a knot and a long dark cast shadow. Its edge density of 0.028 is above the real range of 0.008 to 0.021. B: a plain pale-yellow ledge against a clean orange gradient, close to the apple basket card, with an in-range 0.015. A's backdrop is quiet, so the excess is all in the wood.
pairs.fix: Simplify the tabletop to two or three broad, soft plank shapes with faint grain, no knots and a shorter, softer shadow.

pairs.difference: B: dense ivy runs across the top and down both sides, made of dozens of separately lit leaves, around a door with panels, painted grain and a frame, and the leaf shadows fall on the door. Detail of 0.0353 and edge density of 0.107 both exceed the real range, so the frame outcompetes the wreath. A: a few big quiet shapes of rolling hills, sky and two cloud banks, at 0.0132 and 0.025.
pairs.fix: Remove the ivy, or keep one soft, dark, out-of-focus leaf mass in a corner. Show the door as plain blue with large simple panels and no leaf shadows.

pairs.difference: B: a blue diamond backdrop sits above a pale paving floor of many small cells whose joints fill the lower quarter and waver in perspective. Edge density is 0.041, near the top of the range. A: a violet diamond backdrop over smooth sand with three pebbles, at 0.024. A's floor reads as a few large shapes and B's as a fine grid.
pairs.fix: Replace the paving with a plain smooth ground in one pale tone, with only a few large, faint stone joints or none.

pairs.difference: A: the book lies on a plank table with a rail, a band of individually drawn hedge leaves, a lawn and a cropped pot plant at right. The plant is a large extra prop, and the card sits right at the top limit with edge density 0.089 and detail 0.0304. B: a lamp on wide tone-on-tone teal rays with no props, category 1. Cropping alone does not count against A, because the real lighthouse card also crops.
pairs.fix: Remove the pot plant. Turn the hedge and fence into one soft, blurred green shape behind the table, and keep the table as broad planks.

pairs.difference: A: the planter stands before a full-width picket fence, with bushes on both sides, flagstones, sky and clouds, plus a watering can and trowel on its shelf. That is many mid-sized objects, like the added rope and lifebuoy on the generated lighthouses. Edge density is 0.073 against B's 0.017. B: a backpack on a tone-on-tone red diamond field with a plain orange ledge and no props.
pairs.fix: Remove the watering can and trowel. Replace the bushes and fence pickets with a plain soft wall or sky, and keep the ground as a simple flat stone surface.

pairs.difference: B: the scroll lies on a tilted glossy blue slab with a visible front edge and a smeared reflection blob, against a dark blue gradient. The real ledges in the anchor are matte and level. Detail of 0.0072 is below range. A: a mine cart on soft sand dunes against a plain sky-blue gradient, a clean category 3 at 0.0163 and 0.027.
pairs.fix: Rest the scroll on a matte, level ledge with a straight horizon line, no reflection and one soft contact shadow.

pairs.difference: A: a tone-on-tone blue spiral with a lit centre. B: flat orange waves with no central light. Both are category 1 with no props, and both measure in range at 0.016 and 0.008 edge density. B's unlit field is a small difference, but the real sunscreen card also uses waves, so my vector gives no reliable reason to choose.

B: sand fills the whole card with no horizon or backdrop, with dimples and tiny specks everywhere. Detail of 0.0081 and edge density of 0.003 fall below range. That is unlike the anchor's staging, where real material always meets a simple backdrop. A: a plank table under a quiet tone-on-tone suit-symbol backdrop, in range and purposeful.
pairs.fix: Add a horizon in the upper third with a simple clear sky gradient above the sand, and keep the sand as a few large smooth dunes without specks.

pairs.difference: A: soft violet rays on a very quiet field, slightly below range at 0.0066 and 0.003. B: cyan and blue rays with a bright centre, at 0.0138 and 0.013. That matches the real bouncy castle and baseball glove cards. Both are category 1 with no props, and a slight low reading on A is not a staging fault.

A: bold blue stripes with hard edges run over a plank floor with long dark seams, and the piano stands on it. Detail of 0.0193 and edge density of 0.042 are the higher of the pair and clearly above range. B: pale pink stripes fade into a plain pink floor at 0.0135 and 0.027, also slightly high but quieter. The arch has its own dense leaves, but that is hero detail, not background.
pairs.fix: Lower the contrast between the blue stripes to two close tones, and draw the floor as broad planks with faint seams.

pattern: Generated cards give themselves away by overfilling the card around the hero, not by the hero itself. The lessons show added island bases, rope and lifebuoy props, redder swirling wood grain, a bright halo behind the object and thinner, more numerous rays. In the test pairs the clearest case is p04's wall of separately lit ivy leaves, then p07's many mid-sized objects. Environments there are built from many small drawn items, where real ones use a few large quiet shapes. Softer tells are fine-celled floors, reflective or tilted ledges, and hazy bloom on what should be clean tone-on-tone fields. Only p04 and p07 are firm calls. The other picks are low confidence, because two different subjects leave little to compare on this vector, and p09 and p11 give no reason to choose.
